dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Ah, may the moonlight shine upon your path ahead! Are you two here to pray to Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar as well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Prayer... you mean, in front of this statue? Huh, it really is huge...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Hehe, beautiful, isn't it? This "Idol of the New Moon" was reportedly carved by a Moonchanter from five hundred years ago, depicting Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's original form.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: As for Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's birth and the miracles she performed in this sublunary sphere... I am but a humble acolyte, so I shall refrain from going into too many details with you both.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: In any case, this is the final destination of the pilgrimage route where wishes are offered to Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar. Even if you didn't come here to pray, I hope you shall feel her blessings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon understands now... Eh? Wait, this is the end? Then what's that super imposing pillar up ahead?

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Ahaha... that's not actually a pillar. Beneath it is the "Court of the First Edict", an ancient sanctuary that was sealed off 500 years ago by Moonchanter decree.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: In a sense... you could say it's forbidden ground for us Frostmoon Scions. And because of the Moonchanter's seal, no one can enter anymore, so it's better not to get too close.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: And as for that huge edifice up there... it actually fell from the sky. By Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's grace, none of the falling debris hurt anyone...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Yes, when it came down, several fragments fell from it. One of them fell into the <color=#00E1FFFF>camp below</color>... You two must have seen it on your way here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: As for the other, slightly larger fragments, I remember that they mostly fell to the <color=#00E1FFFF>west</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: In any case, it was surely Lady Kuutar's guidance that brought you both here. Even if you did not come to pray, may the moonlight bless your path ahead.
